Notes:
1) The above financial results were reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on November 13, 2025. The statutory auditors have carried out a limited review of these financials results.
2) Lower crushing owing to lower availability of sugarcane on account of deficit rainfall and pest attack resulting in lower revenue and consequent loss.
3) Exceptional Item of income of Rs.155.84 lakhs is on account reversal of provision relating to Electricity matter (Startup Power).

5) Sugar being a seasonal Industry, the performance of any quarter may not be representative of the annual performance of the Company.
6) The Company did not have any subsidiary/ associate/ joint venture company(ies), as on September 30, 2025.
